riskAnalysis: The principal risks were an arbitrary or duplicate hold installation, mutation of terminal GRR-0001 history, a version-5 reader accepting revision-6 state, an ECR proposal binding a wrong or released hold, review-history flattening, and accidental implementation of the separately governed T03 recovery fix. The implementation adds one clean-commit bootstrap-start compare-and-swap transition, freezes every released hold as a complete immutable record, makes GRR and task identities exact and consecutive, introduces a v3 ECR recoveryAuthority binding, preserves terminal GRR-0001 supplement validation, and leaves command_recover plus all product/reference paths unchanged. The real isolated-Git test installs GRR-0002 after the exact released predecessor and proves duplicate and older-reader denial. The complete affected 129-test matrix passed in 832.639 seconds at candidate af5c4260413cfa8490ca9540784bcecc12d81fac; quality, backlog, both historical ECRs, both GRRs, terminal supplement, generated views, review site, protected-path scope, and diff hygiene also pass.
